text:
marco-docs: PR #628 opened to adjust model-catalog entries for AuroraX-lite (quantized). Main changes: clarify supported context sizes, add a short migration recipe, and include tiny SDK examples. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/628

devin-sdk: nice. Can you add both the generate and stream examples? I can flip them into the TS/JS variants after you drop the Py examples.

lena-ml: bench notes in the PR comment: quantized aurora-x-lite shows p95 inflation past 4096 tokens unless prefix caching is enabled. I recommend calling out p95 and a recommended "safe" max context of 4096 for latency-sensitive apps. gist: https://gist.github.com/lena/aurora-lite-bench-2026

ravi-eng: confirmed on Dedicated repro harness. The runtime falls back from fast_attention_tile to generic_attention for long sequences; adding a runtime note may help SREs. I'll paste sanitized kernel log in the PR.

marco-docs: thanks — action list I have: (1) update CSV row for aurora-x-lite; (2) add a one-paragraph migration guide showing variant pin and fallback policy; (3) include Py + TS snippets showing cache_prefix usage; (4) link the bench gist and paste the sanitized log.

emily-prod: product asks for a one-line callout recommending pinning to aurora-xl for sustained >4k contexts, and a short cost delta note. It should be non-normative but clear.

devin-sdk: draft Py snippet I'm going to paste into the PR:
```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client()
resp = cli.generate(model="aurora-x-lite", prompt=prompt, cache_prefix=True, max_tokens=128)
print(resp.output_text)
```

and a streaming example: 
```python
with cli.stream_generate(model="aurora-x-lite", prompt=prompt, cache_prefix=True) as s:
    for chunk in s:
        print(chunk.text, end='', flush=True)
```

marco-docs: adding TS variants too. Also will reference the kernel log snippet Ravi promised.

ravi-eng: kernel log (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-22T09:14:02Z] model=aurora-x-lite kernel=fast_attention_tile status=fallback reason=tile_unsupported seq=8192
[2026-03-22T09:14:02Z] model=aurora-x-lite kernel=generic_attention p95=420ms
```

lena-ml: note for docs: mention that the p95 on quantized path is higher than float variants at long seq lengths; include the CSV link for numbers not to bloat the page.

ci-bot: [auto] docs-lint: PR #628 failed MD012/MD033 (list indentation and inline HTML). See CI: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/builds/628/logs

marco-docs: will fix lint and push. Quick question: do we want to show an explicit rewrite example for customers migrating from aurora-x-lite to aurora-xl? something like: 
```yaml
fallback:
  - variant: aurora-x-lite
  - variant: aurora-xl
    when: sequence_length > 4096
```

emily-prod: yes, that YAML is helpful. Add a short sentence: "Pin to aurora-xl for predictable latency at the expense of higher token cost."

devin-sdk: once merged I'll add a small SDK helper in our examples package to show `pin_variant(['aurora-xl'])` usage.

marco-docs: OK merging after lint fix + one more engineering +1. Aiming to ship this afternoon. Ping if you spot anything else. :shipit:
